feature: Add Python linting and code quality configuration
workflow_rationale: This is a straightforward configuration task for a single Django backend. It involves adding linting tools (ruff, mypy, bandit) to an existing project with no multi-service dependencies. Simple workflow is appropriate as subtasks can be completed sequentially without complex phase orchestration.

phases.name: Setup and Dependencies
phases.description: Add linting and code quality tools to project dependencies

subtasks.description: Add ruff, mypy, and bandit to pyproject.toml dependencies

verification.expected: Should find ruff, mypy, and bandit in dependencies

subtasks.notes: Successfully added ruff>=0.8.0, mypy>=1.13.0, and bandit>=1.8.0 to [project.optional-dependencies] dev group. Verification passed - all three tools are present in pyproject.toml.

phases.name: Configure Ruff
phases.description: Configure Ruff linter and formatter with Django-specific settings

subtasks.description: Create comprehensive ruff configuration in pyproject.toml
subtasks.notes:
Successfully created comprehensive ruff configuration in pyproject.toml with:
- Line length: 88 (Black default)
- Target version: Python 3.10
- Excluded directories: migrations, static files, cache directories
- Rule sets: E (pycodestyle), F (Pyflakes), I (isort), N (pep8-naming), UP (pyupgrade), B (bugbear), C4 (comprehensions), DJ (Django), DTZ (datetimez), T10 (debugger), and more
- Django-specific ignores for common patterns
- Per-file ignores for __init__.py, tests, manage.py, settings
- isort configuration with known-first-party apps and config
- Format settings: double quotes, space indentation
Verification passed - [tool.ruff] section found in pyproject.toml

subtasks.description: Run ruff check on codebase to verify configuration

verification.expected: Command executes successfully (may report issues but shouldn't crash)

subtasks.notes: Successfully ran ruff check on codebase. Command executed without errors (exit code 0 with --exit-zero flag). Found 4978 linting issues (4935 fixable with --fix), which is expected for first run on existing codebase. The configuration is working correctly - ruff can parse the configuration and scan all Python files in apps/ and config/ directories. Tool installed via poetry run pip install ruff in poetry virtualenv.

phases.name: Configure Mypy
phases.description: Configure mypy static type checker with Django support

subtasks.description: Add django-stubs to dependencies for Django type support
subtasks.notes: Successfully added django-stubs[compatible-mypy]>=5.2.0,<6.0.0 to [project.optional-dependencies] dev group in pyproject.toml. This provides Django type stubs for mypy type checking. Verification passed - django-stubs is now present in the file. The [compatible-mypy] extra ensures compatibility with the installed mypy version (1.13.0).

Successfully created comprehensive mypy configuration in pyproject.toml with:
- Python version 3.10 target
- Django settings module: config.settings
- mypy_django_plugin.main plugin for Django support
- Excluded migrations, venv, build, and dist directories
- Lenient strictness settings for existing codebase (check_untyped_defs, disallow_untyped_calls, etc. set to false)
- Warnings enabled: redundant casts, unused ignores, unused configs, unreachable code
- Pretty error output with error codes and context
- django-stubs configuration section
Verification passed - [tool.mypy] section with django_settings_module found in pyproject.toml. Configuration is ready for type checking Django code with mypy.

subtasks.description: Run mypy on codebase to verify configuration

verification.expected: Command executes without configuration errors (type errors expected initially)

subtasks.notes: Successfully ran mypy on codebase to verify configuration. Fixed configuration by removing duplicate django_settings_module from [tool.mypy] section (should only be in [tool.django-stubs]). Installed mypy>=1.13.0, django-stubs[compatible-mypy]>=5.2.0, prettyconf, and psycopg2-binary in poetry virtualenv. Mypy executed successfully: checked 58 source files and found 46 type errors (expected for existing untyped codebase). No configuration errors detected - mypy is properly configured with Django plugin support via mypy_django_plugin.main. Configuration working correctly.

phases.name: Configure Bandit
phases.description: Configure bandit security linter for Django project

verification.expected: Should find [tool.bandit] section with exclude configuration

subtasks.notes:
Successfully created bandit configuration in pyproject.toml with:
- Excluded directories: tests, migrations, venv, staticfiles, static, media
- Skipped common Django false positives: B308 (mark_safe), B703 (django.utils.safestring)
- Set severity level to MEDIUM to focus on more serious security issues
Verification passed - [tool.bandit] section found with exclude_dirs configuration. Configuration follows the same pattern as other tools (ruff, mypy) in the file.

subtasks.description: Run bandit security scan on codebase

verification.expected: Command executes successfully and produces security report

subtasks.notes: Successfully ran bandit security scan on codebase. Scanned 8,913 lines of code and found 50 Low severity issues (all acceptable): 34 hardcoded passwords in test files (expected for test fixtures), 13 random module usage in sample data generator (acceptable for non-security-critical code), and 3 try/except/pass blocks in printer client (low risk). No Medium or High severity issues detected. Configuration working correctly - bandit properly reads pyproject.toml configuration and excludes tests, migrations, and other specified directories. Command executed successfully using: poetry run bandit -r apps/ config/ -c pyproject.toml

phases.name: Makefile Integration
phases.description: Add linting commands to Makefile for easy execution

verification.expected: Should find new lint, format, typecheck, and security targets

subtasks.notes:
Successfully added linting commands to Makefile with:
- Updated .PHONY line to include: lint, format, format-check, typecheck, security, quality
- Added "Code Quality" section to help menu with descriptions for all commands
- Created 6 new targets:
  * make lint - runs ruff check on apps/ and config/
  * make format - runs ruff format on apps/ and config/
  * make format-check - runs ruff format --check (dry run)
  * make typecheck - runs mypy with pyproject.toml config
  * make security - runs bandit security scanner
  * make quality - runs all checks (lint, format-check, typecheck, security)
- All commands use 'poetry run' prefix to execute in poetry virtualenv
- Follows existing Makefile patterns (tabs for indentation, @ for silent echo)
Verification passed - grep command found all expected targets in Makefile. Committed changes with: auto-claude: subtask-5-1 - Add linting commands to Makefile

verification.instructions: Run: make lint, make format --check, make typecheck, make security. All should execute without command errors (linting issues are OK)

subtasks.notes:
Successfully tested all Makefile linting commands. All commands executed without command errors:
- make lint: Executed successfully, found 4978 linting errors (4935 fixable) - expected for existing unformatted codebase
- make format-check: Executed successfully, found 51 files need reformatting - expected
- make typecheck: Executed successfully with mypy, found 46 type errors - expected for untyped codebase. Configuration loaded correctly from pyproject.toml
- make security: Executed successfully with bandit, found 50 Low severity issues (34 hardcoded passwords in test files, 13 random module usage, 3 try/except/pass blocks) - all acceptable

All tools properly read their configurations from pyproject.toml and run via 'poetry run' prefix. No configuration errors detected. Commands are ready for use by developers.

- Tool descriptions with key features and configuration locations

Verification passed - grep command found all expected keywords (lint, ruff, mypy) in README.md. Committed changes with: auto-claude: subtask-6-1 - Update README.md with code quality section

subtasks.description: Create CONTRIBUTING.md with code quality guidelines

subtasks.notes:
Successfully created comprehensive CONTRIBUTING.md with code quality guidelines in Portuguese (matching README.md style). The document includes:
- Pre-commit workflow guidelines
- How to run linters (ruff, mypy, bandit) with detailed command examples

Verification passed: CONTRIBUTING.md exists and mentions "code quality". File contains 477 lines of comprehensive documentation to help developers maintain high code quality standards. Committed with: auto-claude: subtask-6-2 - Create CONTRIBUTING.md with code quality guideline
